In [[mathematics]], '''negative definiteness''' is a property of any object to which a [[bilinear form]] may be naturally associated, which is [[negative-definite bilinear form|negative-definite]]. See, in particular:

* [[Negative-definite bilinear form]]
* [[Negative-definite quadratic form]]
* [[Negative-definite matrix]]
* [[Negative-definite function]]
